function profile(rows) {
  return v => {
    v=clamp(v,rows[0][0],rows[rows.length-1][0]);
    let lo=0,hi=rows.length-1;
    while(hi-lo>1) {
      const k=(lo+hi)>>1;
      if(rows[k][0]<=v) lo=k; else hi=k;
    }
    const a=rows[lo],b=rows[hi];
    const prev=rows[Math.max(0,lo-1)],next=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,hi+1)];
    const span=b[0]-a[0],t=(v-a[0])/span,t2=t*t,t3=t2*t;
    const out=[];
    for(let k=1;k<a.length;k++) {
      const m=(b[k]-prev[k])*span/(b[0]-prev[0]);
      const n=(next[k]-a[k])*span/(next[0]-a[0]);
      out.push((2*t3-3*t2+1)*a[k]+(t3-2*t2+t)*m+

function finger(parent,name,coords,radii,lightness) {
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(coords.map(p=>point(...p)),false,'centripetal');
  const ax=new V(0,sn,cs);
  grid(parent,name,20,34,(u,t)=>{
    const center=path.getPoint(t),d=path.getTangent(t);
    const side=d.clone().cross(ax).normalize();
    const depth=d.clone().cross(side).normalize();
    const r=values(radii,t),angle=u*TAU;
    center.addScaledVector(side,r*Math.cos(angle)).addScaledVector(depth,r*.85*Math.sin(angle));
    const c=color(0x524635).lerp(color(0x322b22),smooth(.37,.98,t)*.91)
      .multiplyScalar(lightness*(1-.08*gauss(t-.56,.065)));
    return {p:center,c};
  },1,pawMaterial,true);
}

// A seamless studio floor fades into the distant white background.
const floorMat=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms:{
    distant:{value:color(0xf6f8f5)}, nearColor:{value:color(0xc4c5c1)}
  },
  vertexShader:`varying vec3 stageP;
    void main(){
      vec4 p=modelMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);
      stageP=p.xyz;
      gl_Position=projectionMatrix*viewMatrix*p;
    }`,
  fragmentShader:`uniform vec3 distant;
    uniform vec3 nearColor;
    varying vec3 stageP;
    void main(){
      vec2 p=stageP.xz;
      float d=length(p*vec2(.52,1.0));
      float haze=smoothstep(108.0,555.0,d);
      vec3 c=mix(nearColor,distant,haze);
      vec2 q=(p-vec2(20.,-12.))/vec2(89.,54.);
      float shadow=.115*exp(-dot(q,q));
      vec2 a=(p-vec2(-13.,0.))/vec2(14.,16.);
      vec2 b=(p-vec2(57.,0.))/vec2(15.,16.);
      shadow+=.20*(exp(-dot(a,a))+exp(-dot(b,b)));
      float cloud=.0027*sin(p.x*.046+p.y*.017)*sin(p.y*.034-p.x*.013);
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c*(1.-shadow)+cloud,1.);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
    }`
});
